solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique, linked answer split by the grid); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Talk about something that's thrown son

blocks.note: a discus is the disc hurled in athletics
S is the standard abbreviation for son

explanation.surface: Someone debates an object that was hurled at their son.
explanation.definitionFit: To discuss a matter is to talk it over, a plain verb synonym.

clue.text: Start off Friday badly; expert's died having knocked cuts in milk, cheese etc

indicators.note: with its start off, the word loses its first letter
letters arranged badly are in the wrong order and must be reordered
something knocked about is battered out of shape, so the letters are shuffled

blocks.note: taken as written, losing its first letter before rearranging
a pro is an expert; the 's is 'has'
D is the abbreviation for died
taken as written, then rearranged

explanation.surface: A bad Friday: an expert dies after taking budget cuts to milk and cheese.
explanation.definitionFit: Dairy products are foods made from milk, such as cheese, butter and yoghurt.

clue.text: Peter's with UN on day following very big uprising, alive and well

indicators.note: in a down entry, rising up means the letters read from bottom to top
following says the pieces before it come after the piece named next, so the order is swapped

blocks.note: peter is old criminal slang for a safe
and means with or plus
OS stands for outsize, a clothing size
taken as written
D is the abbreviation for day

explanation.surface: Peter and a UN team survive a huge rebellion unharmed.
explanation.walkthrough: Peter looks like a man's name, but it is slang for a safe, as in a safecracker being a peterman.
explanation.definitionFit: Safe and sound is an idiom meaning unharmed, that is, alive and well.

clue.text: Complete policy change when trade union held up vessel

indicators.note: in a down entry, held up means turned so the letters read upwards

blocks.note: TU is the abbreviation for trade union
an urn is a vessel or vase

explanation.surface: A government reverses course after a union delays a ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Vessel' suggests a ship being held up, but it is a pot.
explanation.definitionFit: A U-turn in politics is a reversal of policy, turning right round.

clue.text: Star and husband in Club Med centre soak up some rays

indicators.note: the centre is the middle letter of the word
one piece is placed inside the other

blocks.note: the sun is a star
a bat is a club, as in cricket or baseball
H is the abbreviation for husband
the middle letter of the three

explanation.surface: A celebrity and her husband at a Club Med resort lie in the sun.
explanation.walkthrough: Club Med is a holiday resort chain, but the two words are separated: a club is a bat and Med gives its centre.
explanation.definitionFit: To sunbathe is to lie in the sunshine, which is the idiom soaking up rays.

clue.text: Attend to protecting dog heartlessly penned

indicators.note: without its heart, the middle letter of the word is removed
to protect something is to surround it, so one piece wraps round the other

blocks.note: to heed is to attend to or pay attention to
taken as written, then losing its middle letter

explanation.surface: An instruction to look after a dog that has been shut in, cruelly.
explanation.definitionFit: Hedged means enclosed by a hedge, so fenced in or penned like livestock.

clue.text: Gravelly bottom supports house

indicators.note: in a down entry, a supporting piece sits underneath, so it is written after the other

blocks.note: HO is the abbreviation for house
arse is British slang for the backside

explanation.surface: A rough-textured base holds up a house.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down entry, one piece 'supporting' another sits beneath it, so the bottom comes after the house.
explanation.definitionFit: A hoarse voice is rough and gravelly, a voice-quality adjective.

clue.text: Poor bird has occasionally fusty seed scattered around

indicators.note: taking letters occasionally means every other one
things scattered are thrown about, so the letters fall in a new order
one piece goes round the other

blocks.note: taken as written, then rearranged
a tit is a small songbird
the second and fourth letters

explanation.surface: A hungry bird surrounded by stale scattered seed.
explanation.definitionFit: Destitute means without money or possessions, so very poor.

clue.text: Aristocrat left, disappearing with old money set aside

indicators.note: something disappearing vanishes, so that letter is dropped

blocks.note: an earl is a nobleman
L is the abbreviation for left
the mark was the German currency before the euro

explanation.surface: A nobleman left, vanishing with his old fortune hidden away.
explanation.definitionFit: To earmark funds is to reserve them for a purpose, that is, set them aside.

clue.text: Complaint when fanzine raves about album oddly ignored

indicators.note: ignoring the odd-numbered letters means keeping only the even-placed ones
something that raves runs wild, so the letters go into disorder

blocks.note: taken as written
the second and fourth letters of the word

explanation.surface: A music fan magazine gushes about a record and someone grumbles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'About' here just means 'concerning' in the surface; the two kept letters simply join the fanzine's letters before the mix.
explanation.definitionFit: Complaint is used in its medical sense of an illness, and flu is a common one.

clue.text: Father's new femme fatale?

blocks.note: a sire is a father, especially of an animal
N is the abbreviation for new

explanation.surface: Dad has a new seductive and dangerous woman in his life.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark marks the definition as a loose one: a siren is a seductress, close in spirit to a femme fatale.
explanation.definitionFit: The Sirens of Greek myth lured sailors to their deaths, so a siren is a dangerously alluring woman.

clue.text: Liberal aunt's about to book place to accommodate 16

indicators.note: taken liberally, the letters are treated freely and rearranged

blocks.note: taken as written, then rearranged
re means about or concerning
to book a seat is to reserve it

explanation.surface: A broad-minded relative is about to book somewhere to stay.
explanation.walkthrough: 16 is WILDLIFE, the answer at 16-down. 'Liberal' looks like a politics label but marks the rearrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: A nature reserve is protected land set aside for wild animals and plants to live in.

clue.text: Long, rambling story describing origin of earth

indicators.note: the origin of a word is where it starts, so take its first letter
to describe can mean to trace round, so one piece is drawn around another

blocks.note: a yarn is a long, wandering tale
the opening letter of the word

explanation.surface: A tall tale about how the Earth began goes on and on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Long' looks like an adjective for the story, but it is the verb definition.
explanation.definitionFit: To long for something is to yearn for it, a verb synonym for strong desire.

clue.text: Attacker's in trouble stabbing a shipworker

indicators.note: a knife stabbing something goes into it, so one piece is pushed inside the others

blocks.note: taken as written
read as two words: SS stands for steamship, and the worker ant is the classic worker
to ail is to be in trouble or unwell

explanation.surface: A violent attacker knifes a dockyard worker and now faces trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shipworker' looks like one job title but splits into a ship and a worker, and the trouble goes between the two halves.
explanation.definitionFit: An assailant is one who assails, that is, an attacker.

clue.text: Proper LED fixed inside warning sign

indicators.note: something fixed has been adjusted or rearranged, so the letters are reordered
one piece is placed within the other

blocks.note: right means proper or correct
taken as written, then rearranged

explanation.surface: A light-emitting diode properly installed inside a hazard signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A red light is the standard signal to stop, a warning of danger ahead.

clue.text: A Pinter play has four in Rome confined behind closed doors

indicators.note: to play with letters is to move them around freely

blocks.note: taken as written
IV is four in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A Harold Pinter play is staged in Rome with a cast of four, closed to the public.
explanation.definitionFit: Behind closed doors is an idiom for secretly, out of public view.

clue.text: During earthquake rescued friend

indicators.note: the answer lies within the run of words that follows

blocks.note: letters running across the join of the two words

explanation.surface: A friend was pulled from the rubble after an earthquake.
explanation.walkthrough: Quakers belong to the Religious Society of Friends, so a Quaker is a Friend; the lower-case 'friend' hides that sense.
explanation.definitionFit: Members of the Religious Society of Friends are called Friends, so a Quaker is one.

clue.text: Chaotic existence for flora and fauna

blocks.note: wild means uncontrolled or chaotic
life is existence

explanation.surface: A messy, tumultuous life is the lot of plants and animals.
explanation.definitionFit: Wildlife covers the animals and plants living in nature, that is, flora and fauna.

clue.text: Pretty gutted after leading designer jumper gets saggy

indicators.note: the leading letter is the one at the front of the word
a gutted word has lost its insides, leaving only the outer letters

blocks.note: the opening letter of the word
a roo, short for kangaroo, is a jumper
the first and last letters only

explanation.surface: A pretty designer sweater ends up stretched and baggy.
explanation.walkthrough: A jumper is a British sweater, which the surface wants, but here it is a kangaroo.
explanation.definitionFit: Droopy means hanging down limply, so saggy is a close adjective synonym.

clue.text: Discover second half score and finish late

indicators.note: keeping only the second half means the first half of the word is dropped

blocks.note: taken as written
in cricket a run is a score

explanation.surface: A football match where the second half score is found out and the game ends late.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Second half' looks like part of a match report, but it picks the last four of the eight letters.
explanation.definitionFit: To overrun is to go beyond the allotted time, so to finish late.

clue.text: Oscar's hollow after credit misplaced with Spielberg

definitions.note: an example of the answer, not a synonym

indicators.note: a hollow word has its inside emptied, so only the outer letters stay
letters that have been misplaced are out of position, so they are reordered

blocks.note: taken as written, then rearranged
the first and last letters of Oscar

explanation.surface: An Academy Award goes unfilled after a credit is wrongly attributed to Spielberg.
explanation.definitionFit: Steven Spielberg is a famous film director, so he is an example of one.

clue.text: Visitor's truck stopped by river

indicators.note: something stopped by a plug has that plug in it, so one piece goes inside

blocks.note: a tipper is a lorry that tips its load
R is the abbreviation for river

explanation.surface: A tourist's lorry is halted beside a river.
explanation.walkthrough: In British use a day tripper is a short-stay visitor or tourist.
explanation.definitionFit: A tripper is someone on a day trip or excursion, a holiday visitor.

clue.text: Innocent acts he misconstrued

indicators.note: something misconstrued has been put together wrongly, so the letters are rebuilt

blocks.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A blameless man whose deeds were misunderstood.
explanation.definitionFit: Chaste means pure and virtuous, so innocent in the moral sense.

clue.text: Much loved American singer hides hurt

indicators.note: something hurt is damaged, so the letters are broken up and reordered

blocks.note: Cher is the US pop singer
taken as written, then rearranged

explanation.surface: A beloved US singer conceals that she is in pain.
explanation.definitionFit: Cherished means held dear, which is to say much loved.

clue.text: Carries drinks around hospital

indicators.note: one piece goes round the other

blocks.note: sips are small drinks
H is the abbreviation for hospital, as on road signs

explanation.surface: Someone takes drinks round a hospital ward.
explanation.definitionFit: To ship goods is to transport or carry them.

clue.text: See 2
Looks back over year in country

indicators.note: going back means the letters are read the other way round
one piece is laid over the other, covering it

blocks.note: airs are affected looks or manners, as in putting on airs
Y is the abbreviation for year

explanation.surface: Someone reflects on the past year spent in a foreign land.
explanation.definitionFit: Syria is a country in the Middle East, an example of a nation.

clue.text: Broadcaster cut short umpire, rude about judge and winter sportsperson

indicators.note: cutting a word short trims off its final letter
rude in the sense of crude or rough-hewn, so the letters are left in a rough jumble
one piece is placed round the other

blocks.note: Sky is the British satellite broadcaster
taken as written, then rearranged
J is the abbreviation for judge

explanation.surface: A TV commentator rudely interrupts a referee and judge at a winter event.
explanation.walkthrough: Sky is a UK satellite TV company. 'Rude' reads as an insult in the surface but marks the rearrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: A ski jumper competes in a Winter Olympic sport, so is a winter sportsperson.

clue.text: Attachment of former lover retained by Princess Royal

indicators.note: something retained is held inside, so one piece sits within the other

blocks.note: Anne is the current Princess Royal, the King's sister
an ex is a former partner

explanation.surface: Princess Anne still keeps a fondness for an old flame.
explanation.walkthrough: Princess Royal is a British title held by the monarch's eldest daughter, currently Princess Anne.
explanation.definitionFit: An annexe is a building attached to a larger main one, so an attachment.

clue.text: Authorise to finish gold coating of statue

indicators.note: the coating is the outside layer, so only the outer letters are kept

blocks.note: an end is a finish
or is the heraldic word for gold
the first and last letters only

explanation.surface: Approval is sought to complete the gilding of a statue.
explanation.definitionFit: To endorse a plan is to approve or sanction it, a verb synonym.
